item.title: BBC Inside Science examines AI's impact on mathematics
item.description:
BBC Inside Science examines AI’s impact on mathematics

BBC Inside Science aired a segment titled “The future of mathematics in the age of AI: What next for the world of maths after a major intrusion by AI?”.

🔍 Overview

  • The segment is produced by BBC Inside Science.
  • Title focuses on the future of mathematics in the age of AI after a major intrusion by AI.

💡 Why it matters

  • The programme highlights the question of how mathematics may evolve following a significant AI intrusion.
